request.subject: EFFECT:RAISE

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: seen straight from the front, flat, with no floor, no ground and no perspective, the one shape centred on a transparent background, filling most of the square with a small margin, nothing cropped.

Class: one bold chunky magic effect sprite for a turn-based strategy game map, a single stylised burst with a big simple silhouette, thick single-colour black outline around every shape, flat solid colours with one shadow tone and very few details; it must read at a glance at 40 pixels drawn over grass and over small figures. All colours are solid and opaque, with no soft glow and no gradients. The effect floats alone on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn behind or under it.

layers.text: Subject: two small ivory skeleton hands with bony fingers reaching straight up side by side, as if bursting up from below, the bony wrists wrapped in curling pale blue-white ghostly wisps that fade out at the bottom; no arms above the wrists, no ground, no headstone.
